title: 云海仙踪 第二卷 更隔蓬山一万重 七十六章 换骨云海仙踪 第二卷 更隔蓬山一万重 七十七章 苏公
slug: 云海仙踪更隔蓬山一万重
content_zh:
众道士一边联手克制寒毒，一边入神地听这魔头叙述，他的语调淡然平静，却似冰河暗涌，带着说不出的森冷恨怒，听得众人寒意凛然。
唯有小青听若罔闻，凝神屏气，在许宣掌心一字字地慢慢书写。她体内寒毒极盛，再兼紧张，手指不住地微微颤抖，一笔一画都殊难辨认，反复写了四五遍，许宣才知她写的是：“你只需将金丹真气输入我玄窍，等我固守元神，化作蛇形，便能钻出囚笼，再救出你来。”
许宣心中一动，铜笼球的栅栏间隙不足一尺，孩童也无法钻出，而这妖女的蛇身恰能出入！
惊喜之念方起，又想起自己寒毒未消，动弹不得，如何为她传输真气？铜笼稍有震荡，封印的凶兽立时扑剪而至，她如何能躲避逃出？即便侥幸让小青钻出笼去，她自保不暇，又如何能在众道士的眼皮底下救出自己？登时复转沮丧。
又听林灵素说道：“我又急又怒，想要去抢妹子，又被他猛劈一掌，顿时晕了过去。等到醒来时已是半夜。我半身埋在雪堆里，几已冻僵，想要动弹，全身就像撕裂似的剧痛。被那帮狗贼这通毒打，肋骨断了五根，腿骨、臂骨也全都折断了。
“鹅毛大雪一片片地扑面飞来，四处白茫茫一片，巷子里空无一人。我咬紧牙，挣扎着爬了几步，远处忽然传来狗的叫声，从那景德寺里来了一辆骡车，越驶越近，在我身边停了下来。
“车上探出个高帽长髯的男子，醉眼朦胧地瞪着我，笑道：‘西天在前，红尘在后，碧落黄泉，两皆茫茫。小朋友，你这是要爬向何方？’我想开口骂他，眼前却是一黑，又什么也感觉不到了。
“再醒来时已到了晌午。雪霁初晴，阳光透过窗棂照在房间里，尘糜翻舞。窗外一株青松，几蓬老竹，积雪莹白晃眼，石桌上摆着半局残棋。我躺在床上，盖着锦衾，墙角还有一个火炉，烘得暖洋洋的极是舒服。
“过不多时，两个婢女端着米粥菜肴进来，帮我擦身喂饭。嘿嘿，老子打从娘胎出来，哪有被人这样伺候过？心里一阵恍惚，难道我已经死了，到了西天？那两婢女听了掩嘴直笑，说她们不是仙姑，是牛头马面，等会儿阎王爷就要来了。
“我吃了饭，迷迷糊糊睡了一阵，又听见说话声。睁眼一看，两人站在床前，左边那长髯胖子正是昨晚骡车上的醉汉，右边那人满脸皱纹，年纪似已很大了，头发胡须却仍乌黑如墨，双眼炯炯有神。
“长髯胖子笑道：‘好了，好了，总算醒来了。阎王爷，你瞧这孩子还有得救么？’
“那黑发老头板着脸说：‘你请的什么狗屁庸医？骨头断了，以为接起来就好了么？这小子的两条腿中了刘易知的‘洗髓掌’，筋骨尽断，又在雪地里埋了这么久，再不砍去，腐毒攻心，神仙难救。’”
众人微微一凛，“洗髓掌”是华山白马寺僧人的绝学。当年华山派曾被誉为“小西天”，与峨嵋、南海若无岛并称佛门三山。随着白马寺净悟方丈圆寂，以及徽宗抑佛崇道，华山派的声势大不如前。
金国鞑子攻灭东京后，华山在内的万里河山尽落金人之手，山上大半僧人辗转南下，其势越发凋零。这刘易知既是当年华山的俗家弟子，为何会对两个孩子下此毒手？
许宣心中了然如镜：“这厮身为禁军都指挥使，口口声声奉官家之命，必是知道林灵素李唐后人的身分，因此才百般凌辱，赶尽杀绝。”
小青见他半晌没有应答，又急又恼，一边抬手抵住他的掌心，悄悄地传送真气，一边贴着他的耳朵传音怒道：“小色鬼，‘元婴金丹’乃纯阳至宝，可以克制所有阴寒之物。你只需按照葛仙人的口诀，运转气丹，再逆行于奇经八脉，便能像我这般暂时压制住寒毒。我是冷血之身，无法强撑太久，要想逃命，就得……就得抓紧时机，同舟共济。”说到最后一句时，贝齿连撞，险些说破出声。
许宣听到“同舟共济”四字，突然又想起白素贞来，心头一酸，暗想，横竖是死，只要有半线生机，便当奋力一搏；就算小青出笼后救不了自己，那也聊胜于同归于尽。
当下照着小青所说，意守丹田，逆行真气。
他自幼体弱多病，是因为母亲妊娠时被贼人所杀，早产后经络不通，“先天胎气”封闭不出。吞了元婴金丹后，奇经八脉尽皆畅通，金丹真气与先天胎气化融合一，成为“后天九转金丹”，沉淀于丹田、玄窍之中，一经激发，便层层叠叠地迸将出来，寒意顿时消减了几分，精神大振。
众人浑未察觉，林灵素又道：“长髯胖子微笑道：‘没有这些庸医，又怎能显出你严神医的本事？这孩子年纪尚小，前程无量，若是丢了性命，或没了双腿，岂不可惜？’

“黑发老头哼了一声，伸手摸我胸口，触着那银锁，脸色顿时一变，叫道：‘苏公，你这不是要害我么？我若救了他，丢了双腿的可就是我严某人了。’
“长髯胖子一把抢过银锁，道：‘谁说这孩子姓李了？他是我新收的书童，姓林，大名灵素。’说着向我眨了眨眼睛。我不明所以，但见他将我爹娘所传的银锁夺去，又急又怒，便道：‘我不是你书童！我姓李，叫李灵……’
“黑发老头一把掩住我的嘴，喝道：‘小子，你疯了么？’转头瞪着那长髯胖子，怒道：‘苏公，你不管严某人的性命，也该想想自己。你嫌自己的麻烦还不够多么？’
“那长髯胖子微笑道：‘救人一命，胜造七级浮屠。此事天知地知你知我知而已，有什么可怕？’
“黑发老头恨恨地瞪了他半晌，顿足道：‘罢了罢了！谁叫我欠你一条命呢！’将背上包袱在案头铺展开来，竟是十三柄大小各异的乌金尖刀，光芒闪闪，道：‘小子，我救的是苏公的书童林灵素，与姓李的浑无干系。你日后只要不提我“夺胎换骨严忘一”的名字，就算是莫大的恩情了！’”
众人哄然。
严忘一是神宗、哲宗、徽宗三朝至为著名的神医，药到病除，起死回生，人称“夺胎换骨阎王爷”。此人个性乖僻，喜怒无常，又极为悭吝好财，惟喜爱诗文，常与士大夫唱酬。黄庭坚与他极为稔熟，为了开其玩笑，特将点化前人诗句的手法称为“点铁成金，夺胎换骨”。
许宣听仁济堂的大夫提及他的姓名，每月没有十遍也有八遍，早已如雷贯耳。此时闻及，更有番说不出的滋味儿。
林灵素续道：“我那时没听过严忘一的大名，也不觉得有什么稀奇，但见他握着尖刀在我膝盖上比划，不由心下发毛，奋力挣扎。他按住我的双腿，冷冷道：‘小子，怕死就别怕痛。’我怒气上冲，道：‘谁怕死了？就算你是真的阎王爷我也不怕！’
“严忘一冷笑道：‘小鬼嘴倒挺硬。’从铜盒里挖出一大块白泥，敷在我双腿膝盖上，冰冰凉凉的，过了片刻，竟似麻痹了般什么也感觉不到。他抓起两把尖刀，突然闪电似的左旋右削，还没等我回过神，双腿已被他齐膝卸下。
“我大吃一惊，虽不觉得疼痛，却吓得满身都是汗水，叫道：‘你干什么？’严忘一道：‘旧的不去，新的不来。东西坏了，总得换过，有什么奇怪？’又从角落的铁箱里提起两条苍白的人腿，道：‘像你这等年纪的死人可不好找，尤其是刚死几个时辰的。小鬼，你且将就着用吧。’”
许宣一凛，这番话与林灵素在狱中替他更换脏腑时说得如出一辙，难道这魔头的“百衲之身”竟是从严神医那里学来的？
果听林灵素嘿嘿一笑，道：“点铁成金，夺胎换骨。黄鲁直这八个字概括得可真是精辟不过。多亏了‘阎王爷’这几刀，才让我日后悟出‘百衲之身’的至理要义。这就叫‘万象更新，祸福相倚’。”
顿了顿，又道：‘严忘一用尖刀剔去我膝盖上的断骨残筋，将那双冰冷的断腿接在上面，涂上药膏，用白布层层裹好。我又惊又怕，气血上冲，晕了过去。醒来时已是翌日中午，双腿药效已过，稍一动弹，便剧痛难当。我虽疼得浑身冒汗，但见那两个婢女侍奉在侧，便始终咬牙强忍。
“到了傍晚，那长髯胖子端着一盆红烧肉进来，见我不出一声，掌心抓得鲜血淋漓，大为叹服，道：‘李后主惊才绝艳，原是天下第一等的聪明人，如果有你这等坚忍好胜，又岂会……岂会让人如此扼腕！’
“我心底一震，这才想起我娘病逝前曾抱着我哭过，说我本该是帝胄龙孙，为何竟会如此苦命。我原以为那是她高热时说的胡话，直到那一日，才知道我竟是南唐烈祖的嫡系子孙。

content_en:
While the Taoist priests worked together to restrain the cold poison, they listened intently to the demon's narration. His tone was calm and calm, but like the undercurrent of a glacier, with an indescribable coldness and hatred, which made everyone feel chilled.
Only Xiaoqing listened indifferently, holding her breath and writing slowly in Xu Xuan's palm. The cold poison in her body was extremely strong, and she was nervous. Her fingers could not help but tremble slightly, and it was difficult to identify each stroke. After writing it four or five times, Xu Xuan realized that what she wrote was: "You only need to input the golden elixir true energy into my mysterious orifice. When I stick to my soul and transform into a snake shape, I can get out of the cage and rescue you."
Xu Xuan's heart moved. The gap between the fences of the copper cage ball was less than one foot, and children could not get out, but the snake body of this witch could just get in and out!
The thought of surprise arose, and then I remembered that my cold poison was still lingering and I couldn't move. How could I transmit the true energy to her? The copper cage shook slightly, and the sealed beast immediately pounced on it. How could she escape and escape? Even if Xiaoqing is lucky enough to get out of the cage, how can she save herself under the eyes of all the Taoist priests if she has no time to protect herself? I suddenly became depressed again.
Then I heard Lin Lingsu say: "I was anxious and angry. I wanted to snatch the girl, but he slapped me hard and I fainted immediately. When I woke up, it was already midnight. I was half buried in the snowdrift, almost frozen. I wanted to move, but my whole body was in severe pain like tearing. I was beaten so hard by the gang of thieves that five ribs were broken, and all the leg bones and arm bones were broken."
“Heavy snowflakes were flying in our face in patches, everything was white, and the alleys were deserted. I gritted my teeth and struggled to crawl a few steps. Suddenly, I heard the barking of a dog in the distance. A mule cart came from Jingde Temple, drove closer and closer, and stopped beside me.
"A man with a tall hat and long beard came out of the car. He stared at me with drunken eyes and said with a smile: 'The western sky is in front, the world of mortals is behind, the blue sky is falling in the yellow spring, both are vast. My little friend, where are you crawling to?' I wanted to scold him, but my eyes went dark, and I couldn't feel anything anymore.
“It was already noon when I woke up again. The snow is beginning to clear, the sun shines through the window lattice into the room, and the dust is dancing. Outside the window, there is a green pine, a few old bamboos, the white snow is dazzling, and half a game of chess is placed on the stone table. I was lying on the bed, covered with a brocade quilt, and there was a stove in the corner, which kept me warm and comfortable.
"Not long after, two maids came in with rice porridge and dishes, and helped me clean my body and feed me. Hehe, I have never been served like this since I was born from my mother's womb. I felt in a trance, could I have died and reached the west? The two maids covered their mouths and laughed, saying that they were not fairy maidens, but bull-headed and horse-faced ones, and the Lord of Hell would be coming soon.
“I ate and fell asleep for a while, then heard voices again. When he opened his eyes, he saw two people standing in front of the bed. The fat man with a long beard on the left was the drunkard on the mule cart last night. The man on the right had a wrinkled face and seemed to be very old. His hair and beard were still as black as ink, and his eyes were bright.
"The fat man with the long beard smiled and said: 'Okay, okay, I finally woke up. Lord Hell, do you think this child can still be saved?'
"The black-haired old man said with a straight face: 'What kind of bullshit quack doctor did you hire? If a bone is broken, do you think it will be fine just by reattaching it? This kid's two legs were hit by Liu Yi Zhi's 'marrow-washing palm', and his muscles and bones were completely severed. He had been buried in the snow for so long, and if he didn't cut it off, the poison would attack his heart, and it would be hard for a god to save him. ’”
Everyone was slightly shocked. "Marrow Cleansing Palm" is the unique skill of the monks of the White Horse Temple in Huashan Mountain. At that time, the Huashan Sect was once known as the "Little Western Heaven", and together with Emei and Ruowu Island in the South China Sea, it was also known as the Three Mountains of Buddhism. With the death of Abbot Jingwu of Baima Temple and Huizong suppressing Buddhism and advocating Taoism, the Huashan Sect lost its momentum.
After the Jin Kingdom's Tatars attacked Tokyo, all the mountains and rivers of the Huashan Mountains fell into the hands of the Jin people. Most of the monks on the mountains moved southward, and their power became more and more withered. Since Liu Yizhi was a lay disciple of Huashan back then, why would he do this to two children?
Xu Xuan's heart was as clear as a mirror: "As the commander of the imperial army, this guy keeps talkingShengsheng was ordered by an official to know the identity of Lin Lingsu and Li Tang's descendant, so he humiliated and killed them all. "
Seeing that he didn't respond for a long time, Xiao Qing felt anxious and annoyed. She raised her hand to touch his palm, quietly transmitting Qi, and whispered angrily against his ear: "Little pervert, the 'Nascent Soul Golden Pill' is a treasure of pure yang, which can restrain all yin and cold things. You only need to follow the formula of Immortal Ge, circulate the Qi Pill, and then move backward through the eight extraordinary meridians, you can temporarily suppress the cold poison like me. I am a cold-blooded person and cannot hold on for too long. If I want to escape, I have to... I have to seize the opportunity and work together in the same boat. "When he said the last sentence, his teeth clattered and he almost spoke out.
When Xu Xuan heard the words "we are in the same boat", he suddenly thought of Bai Suzhen, and felt sad. He thought to himself, it was death anyway, and as long as there was half a chance of survival, he would fight hard; even if Xiaoqing couldn't save himself after being released, it would be better than dying together.
At the moment, according to what Xiao Qing said, the intention is to guard the Dantian and reverse the true energy.
He has been frail and sickly since he was a child. This is because his mother was killed by a thief during pregnancy. After premature birth, his meridians were blocked, and the "congenital fetal gas" could not be sealed. After swallowing the Nascent Soul Golden Pill, all eight meridians are unblocked. The true Qi of the Golden Pill merges with the innate fetal Qi to become the "Nine Transformations of the Acquired Golden Pill", which is deposited in the Dantian and Xuanqiao. Once stimulated, it bursts out layer by layer. The chill suddenly subsides a bit and the spirit is lifted.
No one noticed, Lin Lingsu said again: "The fat man with the long beard smiled and said: 'Without these quack doctors, how could you show your ability as a stern doctor? This child is still young and has a bright future. Wouldn't it be a pity if he lost his life or lost his legs? ’
"The black-haired old man snorted, stretched out his hand to touch my chest, touched the silver lock, his expression suddenly changed, and he shouted: 'Mr. Su, aren't you trying to harm me? If I save him, I will be the one who loses my legs.'
"The fat man with the long beard grabbed the silver lock and said, 'Who said this kid's surname is Li? He is my new book boy, his surname is Lin and his given name is Lingsu. ’ He said and winked at me. I didn't know why, but when I saw him taking away the silver lock handed down from my parents, I was anxious and angry, so I said, 'I'm not your book boy! My surname is Li, my name is Li Ling...'
"The black-haired old man covered my mouth and shouted: 'Boy, are you crazy?' He turned to glare at the fat man with the long beard and said angrily: 'Mr. Su, if you don't care about Yan's life, you should think about yourself. Do you think you are not in enough trouble?'
"The fat man with the long beard smiled and said: 'Saving one life is better than building a seven-level pagoda. God knows this and the earth knows it, you know it and I know it, so what's there to be afraid of? ’
"The black-haired old man glared at him bitterly for a long time, then stamped his feet and said: 'That's all! Who told me to owe you a life!' He spread out the baggage on his back on the desk, and there were actually thirteen black gold-pointed knives of different sizes. Mang Shining said: 'Boy, I rescued Su Gong's scholar Lin Lingsu, who has nothing to do with Li. As long as you don't mention my name "Yan Wangyi" in the future, it will be considered a great kindness!'"
Everyone cheered.
Yan Wangyi was the most famous miracle doctor in the three dynasties of Shenzong, Zhezong, and Huizong. He could cure illnesses and bring people back to life with his medicine. He was known as the "King of Hell who took away the body and reborn the body." This person has an eccentric personality, is moody, and is extremely stingy and fond of money. He only loves poetry and often sings with scholar-bureaucrats. Huang Tingjian was very familiar with him, so in order to make a joke, he called the method of enlightening the previous poems "turning iron into gold and changing the body".
Xu Xuan heard his name mentioned by the doctors of Renji Hall eight times if not ten times a month, and he was already very familiar with it. When I smell it now, I have an indescribable taste.
Lin Lingsu continued: "I had never heard of Yan Wangyi's name at that time, and I didn't think it was anything strange, but when I saw him holding a sharp knife and gesticulating on my knees, I couldn't help but feel a hair in my heart and struggled hard. He held down my legs and said coldly: 'Boy, if you are afraid of death, don't be afraid of pain.' I became angry and said: 'Who is afraid of death? Even ifI'm not afraid if you are the real Lord of Hell! ’
"Yan Wangyi sneered and said: 'The kid has a tough mouth.' He dug out a large piece of white mud from the copper box and applied it to my legs and knees. It was cold and cold. After a while, I felt like I was paralyzed and couldn't feel anything. He grabbed two sharp knives and suddenly cut left and right like lightning. Before I could recover, he had removed my legs at knee level.
"I was shocked. Although I didn't feel any pain, I was so frightened that my whole body was covered with sweat. I shouted: 'What are you doing? ’ Yan Wang said: ‘If the old doesn’t go away, the new won’t come. If something breaks, it has to be replaced. Is it any wonder? ’ Then he picked up two pale human legs from the iron box in the corner and said, ‘It’s not easy to find dead people at your age, especially those who died just a few hours ago. Little devil, just make do with it. ’”
Xu Xuan was stunned. These words were exactly the same as what Lin Lingsu said when he replaced his internal organs in prison. Could it be that this devil's "body of hundreds of kilos" was actually learned from the divine doctor Yan?
Guo Tinglin Lingsu chuckled and said: "Turn iron into gold and change your body. Huang Luzhi's eight words can't be more incisive. Thanks to the swords of the 'Lord of Hell', I later realized the true meaning of the 'Body of Hundred Patties'. This is called "everything is renewed, and misfortunes and blessings depend on each other." "
After a pause, he continued: 'Yan Wangyi used a sharp knife to pick off the broken bones and tendons on my knees, connected the cold broken legs to them, applied ointment, and wrapped them in layers of white cloth. I was frightened and frightened, my blood surged, and I fainted. When I woke up, it was already noon the next day. The effects of the medicine on my legs had worn off, and I felt excruciating pain when I moved even a little bit. Although I was sweating all over from the pain, seeing the two maids waiting at my side, I gritted my teeth and endured it.
"In the evening, the fat man with the long beard came in with a pot of braised pork. When he saw me, he didn't say a word, and his palms were dripping with blood. He was very impressed and said: 'Empress Li is amazingly talented and beautiful. He is the first-class smart man in the world. If there is someone as tenacious and competitive as you, how can...how can people be so embarrassed! ’
"I was shocked, and then I remembered that my mother had hugged me and cried before she passed away, saying that I was supposed to be the grandson of Emperor Zhou Long, so why did I suffer such a miserable life. I thought it was nonsense she said when she was high in fever. It wasn't until that day that I realized that I was actually a direct descendant of the Liezu of the Southern Tang Dynasty.
